jobs.title: Environmental Scientist/Industrial Hygiene Technician
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Profit sharing
* Vision insurance
* 401(k) matching
* Bonus based on performance
* Competitive salary
* Dental insurance
**Benefits/Perks**
* Flexible Scheduling
* Competitive Compensation
* 401K
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Health, Dental, Vision Insurance

**Job Summary**
Provides support for a wide range of environmental projects with a focus on hazardous material and indoor air quality testing (asbestos, lead\-based paint, mold, etc.).  


**Company Info \& Job Responsibilities**
Guzi\-West Inspection and Consulting, LLC is seeking qualified candidates to add a member to our Northern California team. A candidate who will succeed in this position is a self starter, with great organization and stellar written and verbal communication skills. Work would include completing hazardous material surveys including testing for asbestos, lead, mold and more, project management, operation of technical equipment, report writing, and much more. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing firm where we truly value every employee. Opportunities to work with GIS applications and in the lab are also available. Health, dental, and vision coverages is offered. All home office equipment (laptop, printer, etc.) will be provided to you.  

  

Minimum Requirements (may be waived with alternative achievements):  

* AA/AS in Environmental Science OR 2\+ Years’ Experience in Construction, Restoration, Inspections/Consulting, or a Related Field


* Understanding of building systems


* Self\-starter with a strong attention and excellent organization skills, capable of working in a fast paced environment


* Have a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, a clean driving record, and willingness to work overtime and travel as projects require


* Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)


* Capable of following safe work practices and company guidelines while climbing ladders, performing site surveys and wearing PPE (Tyvek, respiratory protection), and lifting equipment (\<30lbs).


* Basic map drafting skills



The most competitive applicant may also have some or all the following:  

* Experience in the environmental consulting sector


* Experience working with hazardous materials (asbestos, lead, mold, radon, etc.)


* Have any of the following certifications: (CAC/CSST, CDPH Lead PM or I/A, Asbestos Building Inspector or Contractor Supervisor)


* 4\-Year Bachelor of Science / Degree in Industrial Hygiene (or related).


* Experience preforming mold investigations and home inspections


* Strong technical skills (computer use, report writing, map making, regulatory knowledge, etc.)


* Experience growing a team and handling client relationships



Example of potential day\-to\-day responsibilities:  

* Project management \& hazardous material field surveys


* Running air sampling equipment, taking material samples, microscope analysis


* Managing client relationships \& providing technical guidance on regulatory or environmental subjects


* Commuting to jobsites and transferring equipment


* Job scheduling and other administrative tasks


* Report writing and/or briefing clients on survey results


* Research and training

  


Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Mid-level Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM's** **Environment, Health \& Safety team** is seeking an experienced **Mid\-level Environmental Scientist III** to join our team and support and manage environmental compliance programs for public\- and/or private\-sector clients. This mid\-level role is ideal for a candidate with a solid regulatory foundation who can work independently on routine compliance tasks while supporting more complex projects under senior staff guidance. The successful candidate will contribute to technical delivery, client support, and internal collaboration within a consulting\-oriented environment.

**This hybrid position will be based out of our San Jose, CA office.**

**Key Responsibilities include:**

* Environmental Compliance Support.
* Support implementation of environmental compliance programs related to federal, state, and local regulations (e.g., Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, RCRA, TSCA, EPCRA, and state equivalents).
* Conduct regulatory applicability evaluations, document reviews, and compliance assessments.
* Assist with preparation of permit applications, compliance plans, reports, and regulatory correspondence.
* Support environmental audits and follow\-up corrective actions under direction of senior staff.
* Track regulatory changes and assist with compliance strategy updates.
* Project support \& client interaction.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical support for environmental compliance projects.
* Coordinate with project managers and multidisciplinary teams to meet scope, schedule, and quality requirements.
* Participate in client meetings and site visits as needed.
* Prepare clear, well\-organized technical deliverables and summaries for client review.
* Data Management \& Documentation
* Compile, manage, and analyze environmental compliance data.
* Support development and maintenance of compliance tracking tools and documentation systems.
* Ensure project files and records meet internal quality and compliance standards.

**About AECOM’s Environment Business Line**  

Join AECOM to be part of an expert global team who is connected through a well\-developed, worldwide, internal technical practice network through which you can learn from and brainstorm with the best in the world. AECOM is an industry\-leading, world class environmental firm, and we want you to succeed within it. We respect and encourage your own pathway to excellence via our Freedom to Grow initiative.  

  

AECOM is known for our award\-winning technical excellence, leading\-edge science and innovative project delivery. We provide sustainable solutions for some of the world’s most challenging issues. Our global clients and their projects span a variety of market sectors and geographies and require innovative technical solutions to solve wide\-ranging environmental problems.

 **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, chemistry, or a related field.
* 4 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education focusing on environmental compliance within consulting, industry, or a regulatory agency with strong knowledge of key environmental regulations and compliance frameworks.
* Due to the nature of the work, US Citizenship is required.
* Valid Driver's license and motor vehicle records check is required for this role.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., CHMM, CEA) is a plus.
* 6\+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education focusing on environmental compliance within consulting, industry, or a regulatory agency with strong knowledge of key environmental regulations and compliance frameworks.
* Experience preparing technical reports and supporting environmental permitting or compliance activities.
* Prior experience working in an environmental consulting firm is highly desired.
* Familiarity with state environmental programs and agency interactions.
* Experience with compliance auditing, inspections, or regulatory inspections.
* Proficiency with compliance tracking tools, spreadsheets, or data management systems.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a project\-based environment.

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition

jobs.title: Client Data Management Specialist
jobs.description:
**At Adaptive, we're Powering the Age of Immune Medicine.** Our goal is to harness the power of the adaptive immune system to transform the way diseases are diagnosed and treated.



As an Adapter, you'll have the opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. With Adaptive, you'll create a career highlight through collaboration with bright, curious colleagues working at the apex of innovation and application.



It's time for your next chapter. Discover your story with Adaptive.

 **Position Overview**



The Client Data Management Specialist plays an important role within the Client Data Management (CDM) team and contributes to maximizing Adaptive's revenue through generation and delivery of clinical trial data for high\-value BioPharma customers using Adaptive's MRD assays.



The position works closely with internal stakeholders and BioPharma customers to establish study\-specific Data Transfer Agreements (DTAs) and to generate data of the highest quality as per the specifications of those documents, while meeting internal and external deadlines, keeping study documentation and data delivery methods up to date, and performing data updates.



The position is also responsible for assisting in the design, development, review and maintenance of software code to generate study\-specific customer data files and data analysis tools, and/or to provide project management support to the CDM team.



This role requires impeccable attention to detail, great communication skills, the ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to establish data\-related study requirements and troubleshoot issues, a good command of Adaptive's systems and processes, knowledge of molecular biology and/or high throughput analysis, and the ability to adapt to evolving priorities in a rapidly evolving landscape.


**Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions**


**Deliverable Generation**


* With assistance from the broader team as needed, collects study data and generates, reviews and delivers study files to customers as per study specifications, using multiple internal and external resources as needed in consultation with other CDM team members to deliver data timely and achieve the goals of Adaptive and clients.
* Supports cross\-functional efforts to troubleshoot issues and to ensure study deliverables can be generated in an efficient and timely manner. Cross functional partners include Business Development (BD), Alliance Managers (AMs), Client Managers (CMs), Analytical Project Managers (APMs), and the Sample Management, Software and Computational Biology teams.
* In consultation with other team members, reviews customer data queries, and implements and verifies data cleanup activities as needed for reconciliation needs.
* Supports discussions with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to align data workflows.
* Awareness of client data architecture and lifecycle management needs.


**DTA Management**


* Serves as main point of contact for DTA\-related discussions for assigned customers, including projects of low to medium complexity and scope.
* Participates in training and assists with DTA implementations.
* Monitors and maintains DTAs for assigned customers.
* Drafts and reviews low\-complexity DTAs that meet data needs for new and existing customers, participating in negotiations with customers, and finalizing them under supervision.
* Develops an understanding and awareness of general customer data needs.
* Alerts the CDM team of any conformity issues related to custom clinical database specifications and solves them in collaboration with other team members.
* Uses analytical insights to suggest process improvements and ensures conformity with custom clinical database specifications.


**Client** **Communication**


* Attends meetings with assigned customers (low to medium complexity and scope) and third\-party data managers during study set up and implementation to support customer data needs with team support. Keeps detailed notes for CDM's future reference.
* Responds to client needs and ad\-hoc inquiries using company\-wide systems such as SalesForce, TaskRay, Tableau, Gitlab, JIRA and the data warehouse with support from other team members.
* Suggests process improvements and trains on best practices to systematically address client questions and inquiries.
* Responds to client questions using general understanding of data and biological sciences
* Coordinates communication regarding user access for internal and external platforms.
* Assists in interactions with data\-end users and the data storage/management architecture team to ensure that systems meet business and client needs.


**Software Tool Generation \& Validation (Coding \& Scripting)**


* Under supervision, runs, creates, and maintains JSON scripts to process, clean, and generate study\-specific deliverables for Biopharma study sponsors. Researches and applies solutions to scripting tasks (i.e. Python Documentation)
* Under supervision, creates, implements, and maintains new and existing scripts and enhancements to meet sponsor specific reporting requirements.
* Participates in team efforts to solve low to moderately complex data wrangling efforts.
* Follows established processes for the maintenance of the code repository for data analysis tools. Under supervision, supports the development of new data analysis tools following conventional coding practices to accommodate CDM and BioPharma team needs.
* Utilizes the established tools and processes to ensure quality data collection accuracy and upkeep.
* Assists external user set up and access to data management systems.
* Assists in the development of custom tools to improve and automate existing processes, streamline data workflows, and enable scalable business operations.

jobs.title: Mid-level Environmental Engineer/Geologist/Geological Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Quantum Water \& Environment has an immediate opening for a mid\-level Environmental Engineer/Geologist/Geological Engineer in our Lakewood, Colorado office.

**Responsibilities**

* Support a variety of environmental remediation projects with office and field responsibilities.
* Begin managing small\-scale environmental projects with guidance from senior staff within the first year of employment.
* Up to 50% field work at sites located throughout Colorado. Minimal travel to the surrounding States is possible . Field work includes collection of soil, groundwater, surface water, and soil gas samples. Logging of lithology of monitoring wells via several drilling methods including auger, air, sonic, and mud rotary.
* Support and train entry\-level staff with field sampling techniques.
* Office work includes report writing, spreadsheet production, data quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) and database management.
* Manage tasks and assignments to meet deadlines and budgets.
* Communicate with Project Managers for work assignments.
* May provide support to our Water Rights/Water Resources division.
* Work independently to meet project deadlines.

**Requirements**

* B.S. Degree in Environmental Engineering/Geology/Geological Engineering (or related field) with 2\-7 years of experience in the Environmental Consulting field is required.
* Must be an E.I.T, G.I.T, P.G., or P.E.
* E.I.T.’s and G.I.T.’s will pursue P.E. or P.G. license within applicable time as part of developmental goals.
* 40\-hour HAZWOPER certification is required.
* Strong verbal and written (technical writing) communication skills required.
* Strong, all\-round academic knowledge and understanding of complex scientific technical competencies required.
* QA/QC skills required.
* Possess a positive/can\-do attitude, be flexible and self\-motivated, and have a strong attention to detail.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.

Pay: $72,388\.15 \- $87,177\.13 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health savings account

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Disaster Recovery Cadre
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**


Tetra Tech is adding experienced Cost Estimators to our Disaster Recovery team to support current and future disaster recovery operations across the United States.

**Why Tetra Tech:**


At Tetra Tech, we are *Leading with Science* to solve the world's most complex challenges. Our industry\-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting\-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

**Your Impact:**


Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting\-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world\-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential \- join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

**Position Summary:**


As a Cost Estimator in Tetra Tech's Disaster Recovery Cadre, you will support FEMA Public Assistance and other disaster recovery programs by developing accurate, defensible, and well\-documented cost estimates for infrastructure restoration, emergency work, and permanent work projects. You will evaluate damaged infrastructure, develop and validate project scopes, prepare cost estimates, and support funding eligibility determinations for public facilities and infrastructure.


This is an on\-call, as\-needed position supporting disaster recovery programs following hurricanes, floods, tornadoes, wildfires, earthquakes, and other federally declared disasters. Assignments may be remote, field\-based, or hybrid depending on client needs and project requirements.

**Essential Job Functions:**


The following duties are considered essential to the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions:

 **Project Scoping and Damage Assessment**

* Support FEMA Public Assistance and other disaster recovery programs through project scoping, damage assessment, and cost estimating activities.
* Support site inspections of damaged facilities and infrastructure to understand disaster\-related damages, proposed repairs, and construction requirements.
* Evaluate project scope, means and methods of construction, and restoration approaches.
* Assist with the development and validation of disaster recovery project scopes.
* Collaborate with applicants, engineers, architects, contractors, and program staff to define eligible work and project requirements.

**Cost Estimating**

* Prepare conceptual, parametric, and detailed bottom\-up cost estimates for disaster recovery projects.
* Develop labor, equipment, materials, subcontractor, and general conditions cost estimates.
* Estimate costs associated with repair, restoration, reconstruction, mitigation, and replacement projects.
* Prepare cost analyses for roads, bridges, utilities, buildings, drainage systems, parks, and other public infrastructure.
* Support development of FEMA Cost Estimating Format (CEF) analyses when required.
* Develop estimate documentation that is clear, defensible, and suitable for audit and program review purposes.

**Technical Review and Compliance**

* Review engineering reports, plans, specifications, contractor proposals, and construction cost documentation.
* Evaluate project assumptions, quantities, unit costs, and estimating methodologies.
* Apply knowledge of applicable construction standards, codes, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify cost drivers, scope changes, and factors impacting project eligibility and funding.
* Assist project teams with cost validation, reasonableness determinations, and documentation reviews.

**Program Delivery Support**

* Provide technical estimating expertise to project managers, Public Assistance consultants, and applicant representatives.
* Participate in project formulation meetings and recovery planning discussions.
* Support Requests for Information (RFIs), technical reviews, appeals support, and other recovery program activities.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including engineers, architects, environmental specialists, grant professionals, and construction experts.
* Maintain project records and supporting documentation in accordance with client and program requirements.


**Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in construction estimating, engineering, architecture, construction management, infrastructure planning, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing conceptual, parametric, and detailed cost estimates for infrastructure or facility projects.
* Experience estimating labor, equipment, material, and construction costs.
* Familiarity with modern construction practices, facility assessments, project scope development, and construction inspection activities.
* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary project teams.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Ability to work independently and effectively under changing priorities and demanding schedules.
* Ability and willingness to travel as needed for field assignments.
* Valid driver's license.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Infrastructure Management, or a related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE), Registered Architect (RA), Licensed Contractor, Certified Cost Professional (CCP), Certified Cost Estimator, or similar professional credential.
* Experience using RSMeans, Xactimate, FEMA Cost Estimating Format (CEF), or other industry\-standard estimating platforms.
* Knowledge of FEMA Publ
